security_controls: does not check out or execute pull-request code
runs only for non-draft branches in the same repository
uses the ephemeral GITHUB_TOKEN with declared least-required repository permissions
required_repository_configuration: Allow auto-merge is enabled in repository Settings > General > Pull Requests
GitHub Actions policy permits the workflow's contents: write and pull-requests: write permissions
validation_required: workflow run succeeds on a same-repository pull request
pull request remains blocked until the required code-owner approval and all ruleset requirements pass
GitHub merges only after those requirements pass
